description: This file defines the PackageManagerComm class, which manages communication with a remote depot server for package management tasks such as login, download, and retrieval of package info in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

classes.name: PackageManagerComm
classes.description: A class providing static and instance methods to communicate with the package depot server, including login, logout, package retrieval, download, and update checks.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SOAP client and optionally logs in to the depot.

methods.name: errorCheck
methods.description: Checks for errors in the last SOAP response.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets user credentials in session variables.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the session ID for re-authentication.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs into the depot server, establishing a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out from the depot server.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Fetches categories and packages for a given category ID.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches subcategories for a given category ID.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Fetches packages under a specific category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Fetches releases for a specific package.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Adds a download request to the queue.

methods.name: performDownload
methods.description: Performs the actual download using curl.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Retrieves terms and conditions from the depot.

methods.name: downloadedDocumentation
methods.description: Logs that a documentation document has been clicked.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for updates for installed objects.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Pings the server to verify communication.
